name: High School Blues
source:
Himari's life couldn't get any more worse when her parents encounter a divorce. She is forced to stay with her dreadful mother, who only cares about herself and watches rom-coms in her spare time. Life couldn't get any more harder, when she has to move to another town. 

What awaits her is worse than anything she could have ever imagined. But who knows? The cloud could have a silver liner. Full of love and lessons to be taught.

[From [url=https://strxberrybliss.itch.io/high-school-blues]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
父母离婚后，希玛丽的生活变得更加糟糕。她被迫和可怕的母亲住在一起，她只关心自己，闲暇时看浪漫喜剧。当她不得不搬到另一个城镇时，生活变得更加艰难。

等待着她的，比她想象的还要糟糕。但谁知道呢？云可能有一线希望。充满爱和需要教导的教训。
